purpose: Teach: 原型/員数/及ぶ/お上/摘発/人並み/語り口/長らく

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の、本気で、絶対、原型、絶対、できあがりましたね
lines.en: The new product prototype is finally complete.
lines.style: Calm, measured delivery. Forward momentum without urgency. Slight upward lift on the final word, as though presenting a concrete fact to a colleague.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、員数、絶対、ピッタリ、絶対、揃いました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We got the staffing exactly right. I'm grateful for everyone's effort.
lines.style: Even, responsive tone. Affirming without excess. A beat of genuine appreciation on the gratitude, but kept professional and understated.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 販売影響、本気で、絶対、海外、絶対、及ぶ、絶対、見込みです
lines.en: We're projecting this will have sales impact internationally.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Confident on the projection. Slight pause before 'internationally' — marking the scope. Authoritative but not forceful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、お上、絶対、の、絶対、新規制、絶対、社内、絶対、説明、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively working with the authorities on the new regulations and communicating them internally.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Each phase of the process gets equal weight. Competent and reliable. Ends on the note of gratitude — sincere but restrained.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 不正、本気で、絶対、摘発、絶対、社内、絶対、教育、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we advance our internal education on fraud prevention.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative — a light leadership touch. Slight emphasis on 'advance,' drawing Kenji in as a partner. Clear priority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、人並み、絶対、以上、絶対、頑張っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our staff is performing well beyond expectations. We're grateful for their commitment.
lines.style: Warm underneath the professionalism. A moment of real pride on 'performing well.' Closed with the gratitude — genuine, not formulaic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広報、本気で、絶対、語り口、絶対、丁寧にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our public communications remain careful and thoughtful.
lines.style: Measured direction. Emphasis on 'careful' — this matters. Collaborative tone, not commanding. The kind of guidance that asks for partnership.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、長らく、絶対、お得意様、絶対、大切にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've always valued our long-standing clients, and we're committed to continuing that.
lines.style: Warm closing statement. Slight nostalgic weight on 'long-standing.' Sincere and grounded. Ends with quiet confidence in the relationship.
